10266|b17b8494.name: Ug'thok
10266|b17b8494.text: I can show you what you wish to know, but you must be patient. Take your time to work the steel and feel the way it shapes beneath your hammer. When you become one with the steel, then you will understand.

10881|dc8290dc.name: Bluff Runner Windstrider
10881|dc8290dc.text: Greetings and salutations, hero!  I have the latest news from both continents and points beyond for your consideration.

11025|f03c89ad.name: Mukdrak
11025|f03c89ad.text: You know who can really show you some things? Nogg! You go find him in Orgrimmar.

11048|2479a86b.name: Victor Ward
11048|2479a86b.text: Yes, I think you have potential. Maybe I can show you a thing or two.

1744|9a74b5f1.name: Deathguard Mort
1744|9a74b5f1.text: You can find Vance Undergloom upstairs in a room at the Gallows' End Tavern on the southeast side of Brill.

2124|7d510daf.name: Isabella
2124|7d510daf.text: Greetings.  I'm an $r $c trainer, and you're a $c.

2857|31f4573e.name: Thund
2857|31f4573e.text: You know who's really smart? Nogg! Smarter than me, even. You go tell Nogg Thund sent you! You can find him by the control panel over there.

2857|6139c96a.name: Thund
2857|6139c96a.text: Who says Orcs aren't smart? It takes a lot of brains to be an engineer!

3153|640f312b.name: Frang
3153|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a $c's time.

3154|515c0157.name: Jen'shan
3154|515c0157.text: Hey mon, you be needin' to head on over to da $c trainer.

3169|640f312b.name: Tarshaw Jaggedscar
3169|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a $c's time.

3174|7befd912.name: Dwukk
3174|7befd912.text: I hear one comment about waterfowl, and you will be eating through a tube.

3354|640f312b.name: Sorek
3354|640f312b.text: Are you here for training?  Or are you just here to waste a $c's time.

1881-accept.name: Cain Firesong
1881-accept.text: $N, Anastasia Hartwell has a task for someone of your talents.  Speak with her in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity, and prepare yourself for your first task for the mages of the Forsaken.
1881-accept.title: Speak with Anastasia

2383-accept.name: Gornek
2383-accept.text:
Ah, while you were gone a parchment came for you, $N.

Read it when you have time. If I'm not mistaken, it came from the $c trainer Frang. He would have words with you when you're ready. You'll find him outside the Den, taking cover in the shade.
2383-accept.title: Simple Parchment

2383-complete.name: Frang
2383-complete.text:
Ah, that's my parchment.  I heard you'd be coming to the Valley, $N.  I'm glad to see you made it--let's hope you survive the trials ahead. Like I said, as you gain in power, come to me--I will do what I can to train you in the ways of the $c.

Good luck, $N, and return to me whenever you feel ready.
2383-complete.title: Simple Parchment

2383-progress.name: Frang
2383-progress.text: What's that you have there?  A parchment?  You're not a scholar, I hope...
2383-progress.title: Simple Parchment

3098-accept.name: Shadow Priest Sarvis
3098-accept.text: Ah, while you were off dealing with the mindless Scourge, this scroll arrived for you. I would think it's some matter of importance as it seems it bears the seal of the $c trainer Isabella. I would take some time to read it before heading out again.
3098-accept.title: Glyphic Scroll

3098-complete.name: Isabella
3098-complete.text:
You must return to me often if you are to become powerful enough to destroy those who would oppose us. The rules of magic still apply to you, $N. You will still find corruption follows you like hungry wolves in the night. You will find its caress is not unlike an addiction, an old lover still wanting to be by your side. But these things can be staved off. These things will only control you if you allow them to.

Go now, return to me when you've grown more powerful.
3098-complete.title: Glyphic Scroll

3098-progress.name: Isabella
3098-progress.text: I knew you would come to me, $N. Not because you do not have the will to follow your own path, but because we are kindred spirits. We both have felt pain. We have both suffered. And now we want the power to take back what we know is ours: this land, our lives, our destinies. But there is much for you to learn still.
3098-progress.title: Glyphic Scroll

365-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
365-progress.text: Deathguard Simmer sent word that you were going to provide me with some much needed reagents.  Were you able to gather 10 pumpkins yet, $N?
365-progress.title: Fields of Grief

367-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
367-progress.text: Have you collected 5 vials of darkhound blood yet, $N? Time is fleeting!
367-progress.title: A New Plague

375-progress.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-progress.text: Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread yet, $N?
375-progress.title: The Chill of Death

376-progress.name: Novice Elreth
376-progress.text: Do try your best to keep yourself unharmed until I get you some armor.
376-progress.title: The Damned

381-progress.name: Executor Arren
381-progress.text: Those fools... They happily send themselves to their own graves.
381-progress.title: The Scarlet Crusade

3902-progress.name: Deathguard Saltain
3902-progress.text: Have you managed to scavenge up some useful items for us?  There is no shame in reusing that which has been tossed aside.  No one is going to give us any handouts - we Forsaken will fend for ourselves!
3902-progress.title: Scavenging Deathknell

404-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
404-progress.text: Have you completed the task with which I have charged you?  Do you have those putrid claws?
404-progress.title: A Putrid Task

407-progress.name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
407-progress.text:
Stay away, foul and unholy creature!  May the Light protect me!  The Scarlet Crusade shall rid Azeroth of your. . .

. . .oh wait.  Is that food for me?  I am so hungry. . .
407-progress.title: Fields of Grief

5481-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5481-progress.text: Where's that useless abomination? Either you have what I need or you'd best get out there and find it.
5481-progress.title: Gordo's Task

8-progress.name: Innkeeper Renee
8-progress.text:
Yes? Yes? What is it?

The forsaken; they certainly do have huge appetites. Make yourself at home... yes, rest those weary bones. My name's Renee if you need anything at all.
8-progress.title: A Rogue's Deal

96874-accept.name: Ug'thok
96874-accept.text:
Have you seen the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge? I keep thinking the spines on their backs would be perfect for crafting the head of a mighty axe. Saru laughed when I told him... but what does he know!?

As part of your smithing lessons, you can help me out! Bring me some of those spines, along with grinding stones to sharpen them.
96874-accept.title: This Is Spinal Axe

97900-accept.name: Brakk
97900-accept.text:
So, you've become a Blacksmith. That's a great choice if you want to make sure your blades never dull.

I reckon I know someone that can help with that by teaching you how to craft a Sharpening Wheel. Bring one of these out at your camp and all the warriors and rogues in the area will be lining up to hone their weapons.
97900-accept.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97900-complete.name: Dwukk
97900-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Sharpening Wheel. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97900-complete.title: Camping 101: Blacksmithing

97902-accept.name: Brakk
97902-accept.text:
Engineers like yourself can cook up all sorts of bits, bots, and bombs for fun and profit.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Reagent Bot for your camp. This helpful automaton can help keep you well-supplied so that you and your allies never run out of the materials needed to fuel your spells.
97902-accept.title: Camping 101: Engineering

97902-complete.name: Mukdrak
97902-complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Reagent Bot. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.
97902-complete.title: Camping 101: Engineering

97903-accept.name: Brakk
97903-accept.text:
So you've taken up First Aid? That's an honorable... and pragmatic pursuit as a $c.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a First Aid Kit for your camp. Injuries are a reality in the world of adventuring and offering some much-needed healing at your camp could even save lives.
97903-accept.title: Camping 101: First Aid

98389-accept.name: Aramis Hammerhand
98389-accept.text:
Greetings, $c. Yes, I am a paladin. Not even death can stop the Light.

This is something my kind have in common with all Forsaken--we have overcome what the living view as their end. However, some even among our own fear us; they suspect we will smite them as some monstrosity.

In truth, our relationship with undeath is complex, but I am not here to hurt our own. Help me show the others this. Venture to Night's Web Hollow to the northwest and free the freshly raised fools trapped by the spiders there.
98389-accept.title: A Light in the Darkness

99141-progress.name: Executor Zygand
99141-progress.text: You'd best have those reports in hand, or get out of my face.
99141-progress.title: Patience
